# authwise_theme (Data Source)

A tenant theme: the stylesheet and content the hosted login pages render with. Start from a layout's starter (`GET {issuer}/api/v1/ui/layouts`): its stylesheet template, `stylesheet_attributes` and `content`, and its two schemas. `layout` is fixed at creation; kit refuses a change, so another layout is another theme. Colours in `stylesheet_attributes` are six hex digits without `#`. An asset is named in `content` by its served URL, `/assets` plus the asset's `path`. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String)
- `content_schema` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `layout` (String)
- `placeholder_content` (String)
- `placeholder_stylesheet_attributes` (String)
- `stylesheet` (String)
- `stylesheet_attributes` (String)
- `stylesheet_attributes_schema` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `theme_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
